verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a community post quoting Morph's privacy policy. The quoted policy says the Enterprise tier does not use submitted code for anything beyond the immediate request, while the Free tier may use code for training. The commenter also suspects paying non-enterprise users may be trained on. So no-training protection appears tied to the Enterprise tier rather than being an option every user can switch on. missing for 10: first-party privacy or data-use documentation in the pack, a user-controllable opt-out for non-enterprise tiers, clarity on paid non-enterprise tiers, and coverage of non-code data such as chat prompts.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models

citations.quote: Enterprise Tier: We do not use your submitted code data for any purpose other than processing your immediate request.
